blind_spots.blind_spot: Networked cameras and AI software on an Air Force depot floor with no accreditation path mentioned

blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The product grew up on commercial 3D-printing floors where 'easily incorporated into existing equipment' really is just an install
blind_spots.evidence_quote: the solution will be ready for deployment at REACT's machines at Tinker AF base and Air Force Research Labs (AFRL).

blind_spots.blind_spot: Build reports and layer imagery of defense parts are export-controlled technical data

blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Commercial customers want open data sharing; nothing in their market pulled them toward export-control discipline
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Addiguru's open policy allows different machine manufacturers, sensor providers, and software companies to easily integrate our technology

blind_spots.blind_spot: No CMMC/NIST 800-171 posture for a company about to hold AF depot data

blind_spots.evidence_quote: US Defense (DoD) and global commercial users and partners
